description: Full-text search across all memory layers using FTS5. Supports layer/entity/date/scope filtering. Returns scored results with snippets. Superseded entries excluded by default.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 date to filter temporal facts. Only returns memories where valid_from <= as_of and valid_until >= as_of (nulls treated as unbounded).

date_from.description: Filter by event date (event_at if set, else created_at) >= ISO 8601 datetime

date_to.description: Filter by event date (event_at if set, else created_at) <= ISO 8601 datetime

entity_name.description: Filter by entity name (exact match, supports aliases)

include_superseded.description: Include superseded (outdated) memories in results (default false)

layers.description: Filter by memory layers (default: all layers)

mode.description: Search mode: fts=FTS5 tokenized (default), exact=LIKE substring, vector=embedding similarity (requires MNEMON_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER), hybrid=FTS5+vector with RRF fusion

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination, default 0)

query.description: Search query — free text, tokenized for FTS5

name: memory_search
